intent.raw_query: Thailand beaches, $1800 for couple, mix of island hopping and street food, October 2026

experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Snorkeling & Island Hopping Tour
experiences.description: Embark on a full-day speedboat tour hopping between the stunning Phi Phi islands, including Maya Bay (made famous by The Beach), Monkey Beach, and Pileh Lagoon. Snorkel in crystal-clear turquoise waters teeming with colorful marine life and explore dramatic limestone karsts rising from the Andaman Sea.

experiences.name: Bangkok Street Food Night Walk in Yaowarat
experiences.description: Dive into Bangkok's legendary Chinatown street food scene after dark. Sample iconic dishes like pad thai, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, fresh oyster omelets, and exotic durian from bustling roadside stalls and hawker carts. Join a guided food walk or explore independently along the neon-lit Yaowarat Road.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta Sunset Beach Kayaking
experiences.description: Paddle a sea kayak through the calm mangrove channels and hidden sea caves surrounding Koh Lanta, finishing with a breathtaking sunset view over the Andaman Sea from a secluded beach. This experience combines adventure, nature, and stunning coastal scenery in one of Thailand's most laid-back island destinations.

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Old City Temple & Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the ancient walled city of Chiang Mai on foot, visiting ornate temples like Wat Chedi Luang and Wat Phra Singh, then dive into the famous Saturday or Sunday Walking Street markets. Feast on northern Thai specialties such as khao soi (coconut curry noodles), sai oua (herb sausage), and nam prik noom (green chili dip) from local vendors.

experiences.name: Similan Islands Liveaboard Snorkel & Dive Experience
experiences.description: Join an overnight or day-trip liveaboard to the world-renowned Similan Islands, a protected national marine park featuring some of Southeast Asia's most pristine coral reefs. Snorkel or dive alongside whale sharks, manta rays, sea turtles, and vibrant reef fish in waters of exceptional clarity. Relax on powdery white sand beaches between dives.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Thailand
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration and customs, collect baggage, and arrange airport transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in and settle into your beachfront accommodation. Take a short stroll along the beach to unwind after the flight.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or skip
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court (budget 150-200 THB)
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite from a 7-Eleven or nearby street food stall near the resort (budget 80-120 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Keep some Thai Baht ready for transfer and tips. Exchange currency at the airport for convenience. Most 7-Elevens are open 24/7 and are great for late-night arrivals.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up and enjoy your first proper Thai breakfast. Walk along the beachfront near Aegean Bliss Resort to get your bearings. Explore the local beach area, watch the sunrise over the ocean, and take photos of the scenic coastline. Visit a nearby morning market to pick up fresh tropical fruits.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a scooter or bicycle (150-200 THB/day) and explore the local area around the resort. Visit a nearby temple or local village to soak in the culture. Head to the nearest beach viewpoint for panoramic coastal views. Browse local shops for affordable souvenirs and snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the nearest night market or walking street for dinner. Sample classic Thai street food including Pad Thai, Som Tum (papaya salad), and grilled satay skewers. Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere with live music and local vendors.

meals.breakfast: Fresh fruit and coconut pancakes from a beachside street stall (60-100 THB)
meals.lunch: Local restaurant near the beach — try Khao Man Gai (chicken rice) or noodle soup (80-120 THB)
meals.dinner: Night market street food spread — Pad Thai, grilled corn, mango sticky rice (150-200 THB)

day_by_day.notes: October is part of Thailand's rainy season in some regions. Carry a compact rain poncho. Check local weather before planning water activities.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling trip from the beach near the resort. Rent snorkeling gear locally (150-200 THB) or join a budget group snorkeling tour. Explore colorful coral reefs and spot tropical fish in the clear turquoise waters close to shore.
day_by_day.afternoon: Island hopping by longtail boat — book a shared group boat tour (400-600 THB) to visit 2-3 nearby smaller islands. Enjoy white sandy beaches, swim in crystal-clear lagoons, and explore hidden coves. Pack your own snacks and water to save money.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and freshen up. Walk along the beachfront promenade at sunset. Dine at a local beachside seafood restaurant and try grilled fish or prawns with steamed rice at local prices.

meals.breakfast: Banana pancakes and fresh juice from a street cart near the beach (60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Pack sandwiches or buy snacks from 7-Eleven before the boat tour to save money (80-100 THB)
meals.dinner: Beachside seafood restaurant — grilled fish with rice and a cold Chang beer (200-280 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Book group island hopping tours through your resort or local tour operators for the best budget deals. Avoid private boat charters to keep costs low.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a local Buddhist temple in the morning for a cultural experience. Dress modestly (cover shoulders and knees). Participate in merit-making by offering alms to monks if the opportunity arises. Explore the temple grounds and admire traditional Thai architecture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to a local fresh market (Talad Sod) in the afternoon to experience authentic Thai market culture. Sample local snacks like fried insects (for the adventurous), fresh spring rolls, and tropical fruits. Pick up affordable local spices and dried goods as souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Join a budget Thai cooking class in the evening (500-700 THB) if available locally, or alternatively, find a rooftop bar or beach bar for a sundowner drink. Explore the local street food scene for dinner with a variety of grilled meats and noodle dishes.

meals.breakfast: Jok (Thai rice porridge) with egg from a local street stall (50-70 THB)
meals.lunch: Fresh market food — fried rice, spring rolls, grilled pork skewers (100-150 THB)
meals.dinner: Street food dinner near the night market — green curry with rice, fresh spring rolls (150-180 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Many temples are free to enter but request a small donation. Always remove shoes before entering temple buildings and dress respectfully.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day beach relaxation morning. Find a quiet stretch of beach near the resort. Swim, sunbathe, and enjoy the natural beauty. Try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) rental from the beach (200-300 THB/hour) for a fun water activity.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a nearby national park or nature reserve by scooter or local songthaew (shared taxi). Hike a short trail through jungle terrain to a scenic viewpoint or waterfall. Enjoy the lush tropical greenery and wildlife spotting.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cruise on a budget longtail boat (200-300 THB per person for shared tours). Watch the golden sunset over the Andaman Sea or Gulf of Thailand. Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxed evening at a beachfront bar with local cocktails.

meals.breakfast: Toast with peanut butter and fresh fruit from a guesthouse cafe (60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Beachside shack lunch — fried rice with egg or tom yum soup (100-130 THB)
meals.dinner: Local Thai restaurant away from the tourist strip for authentic flavors and lower prices — Massaman curry with rice (150-200 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Eat at restaurants slightly away from the main tourist beach strip to get more authentic food at lower prices. Look for places filled with locals.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early morning day trip by ferry or speedboat to a nearby famous island (e.g., Koh Phi Phi, Koh Tao, or Koh Lanta depending on your base location). Book a shared group day-trip ferry for maximum savings (300-500 THB round trip).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the island on foot or by renting a bicycle. Visit the island's main viewpoint for breathtaking panoramic views. Swim at the island's most scenic beach and snorkel in the shallow reefs. Grab lunch at a local shack on the island.
day_by_day.evening: Return by ferry before sunset. Freshen up at the resort. Head out for a street food dinner and browse the evening walking street for handmade crafts, clothing, and accessories.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the pier before boarding the ferry — roti with banana and condensed milk (50-70 THB)
meals.lunch: Island beach shack lunch — fried noodles or pad see ew (120-160 THB)
meals.dinner: Walking street food — grilled squid, fried rice, fresh coconut (180-220 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Book ferry tickets in advance during peak season. Carry sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water for island day trips. October weather may bring afternoon rain showers.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning at the resort. Enjoy the resort's beachfront area. Take a morning yoga session on the beach if available (many resorts offer free or low-cost sessions). Journal, read, or simply enjoy the sound of the waves.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local fishing village nearby to experience authentic Thai coastal life. Watch fishermen bring in their daily catch, explore colorful wooden boats, and interact with friendly locals. Buy fresh seafood directly from fishermen at very low prices.
day_by_day.evening: Cook or have fresh seafood prepared at a local restaurant using the fish you purchased from the village. Alternatively, attend a traditional Thai cultural show or fire show at a beachside venue. Enjoy the festive atmosphere with other travelers.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or nearby cafe — eggs, toast, and fresh fruit (80-120 THB)
meals.lunch: Fishing village local eatery — fresh fish curry with rice (100-140 THB)
meals.dinner: Beachside BBQ seafood dinner — grilled prawns, squid, and fish with dipping sauces (250-350 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Mid-trip rest day is important to recharge. Use this time to do laundry (laundry services are very cheap in Thailand, around 50-80 THB per kg) and plan the second half of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning kayaking adventure along the coastline. Rent a single kayak (150-200 THB/hour) and paddle through sea caves, limestone cliffs, and hidden lagoons. Explore areas not accessible by larger boats for a truly unique experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local elephant sanctuary or wildlife rescue center (if available in your region) for an ethical wildlife experience. Observe elephants in their natural habitat without riding them. Budget ethical sanctuaries cost around 800-1200 THB but are worth the experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a traditional Thai massage on the beach (200-300 THB for 1 hour) to soothe tired muscles. Dine at a local Thai restaurant and try dishes you haven't eaten yet.

meals.breakfast: Street cart breakfast — khao tom (rice soup) with ginger and pork (60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Sanctuary canteen or pack your own lunch from a convenience store (100-150 THB)
meals.dinner: Local Thai restaurant — try Panaeng curry or Khao Pad (fried rice) with fresh vegetables (150-180 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Always choose ethical elephant sanctuaries that do not offer riding. Research and read reviews before booking. This is a highlight experience worth budgeting for.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget overnight or early morning bus/ferry combination to a different island or coastal destination for a change of scenery (if your itinerary allows movement). Alternatively, explore a different beach on the same island by scooter.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at the new beach destination and explore the area. Visit local viewpoints, beach caves, or natural rock formations. Swim and snorkel at a less-crowded beach for a more peaceful experience.
day_by_day.evening: Find a beachfront bungalow bar or restaurant for the evening. Enjoy a cold Singha beer and fresh spring rolls while watching the waves. Explore the local night scene at a budget-friendly beach bar with live acoustic music.

meals.breakfast: Convenience store or ferry pier food — sandwiches and coffee (60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: New destination local restaurant — try regional specialties unique to the area (120-160 THB)
meals.dinner: Beachfront bar dinner — fish tacos or grilled chicken with papaya salad (200-250 THB)

day_by_day.notes: If moving between islands, book transport tickets at least a day in advance. Shared minivans and public ferries are the most budget-friendly options.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise beach walk and meditation on a quiet stretch of sand. Collect shells and enjoy the peaceful early morning atmosphere. Join a free beach yoga session if available at a nearby resort or yoga studio.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore local street food neighborhoods in the nearest town. Join a self-guided street food tour — try boat noodles, mango sticky rice, Thai iced tea, and crispy pork belly rice. Visit a local fresh market and sample as many dishes as possible.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a local cultural event or festival if happening during your visit. October sometimes coincides with Thai festivals like Ok Phansa (End of Buddhist Lent). Watch traditional boat races or lantern releases if available.

meals.breakfast: Beachside smoothie bowl or acai bowl from a health cafe (100-130 THB)
meals.lunch: Street food tour lunch — multiple small dishes from different vendors (150-200 THB total)
meals.dinner: Festival food stalls or night market — Thai crepes, grilled meats, coconut ice cream (180-220 THB)

day_by_day.notes: October 2027 may coincide with Ok Phansa (Buddhist Lent End), which features beautiful boat races and candlelit processions. Check local event calendars upon arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Take a full-day snorkeling and island hopping boat tour to a marine national park (e.g., Ang Thong Marine Park, Similan Islands, or Tarutao depending on location). Book a shared group tour (600-900 THB) for the best value. Bring your own snacks and water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island hopping tour — visit multiple islands, swim in emerald lagoons, and hike to viewpoints. Snorkel around vibrant coral gardens and spot sea turtles, rays, and colorful reef fish.
day_by_day.evening: Return from the tour by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a relaxed evening. Treat yourself to a slightly nicer dinner as a mid-trip celebration — try a proper Thai restaurant with a full set menu.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the pier — roti with egg and tea (60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch included in the tour or buy from pier vendors (included or 100-150 THB)
meals.dinner: Treat yourself to a nicer Thai restaurant — seafood platter with rice and soup (300-400 THB)

day_by_day.notes: National park entrance fees (200-400 THB) are usually included in group tour prices. Confirm before booking. Bring reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral.

day_by_day.morning: Last full day of exploration. Start with a final morning swim and beach walk. Visit any remaining local attractions or beaches you haven't explored yet. Rent a scooter for one last scenic coastal drive.
day_by_day.afternoon: Shopping for souvenirs and gifts at the local market or walking street. Look for handmade crafts, Thai silk scarves, elephant pants, and local spices. Practice bargaining politely for better prices. Visit a local pharmacy to stock up on Tiger Balm and other Thai health products.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at your favorite street food spot or beachside restaurant. Order all your favorite Thai dishes one last time — Pad Thai, green curry, tom yum soup, and mango sticky rice for dessert. Watch the sunset over the ocean.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or local cafe — full Thai breakfast with rice, egg, and sausage (80-100 THB)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a beach shack — fresh spring rolls and iced coffee (100-130 THB)
meals.dinner: Farewell feast at a beloved street food stall or beachside restaurant — all your favorites (250-350 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Budget around 500-1000 THB for last-minute souvenir shopping. Vacuum-sealed Thai snacks and instant noodles make great affordable gifts. Start packing tonight to avoid morning rush.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Thailand. Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach. Take final photos and soak in the atmosphere. Enjoy a slow breakfast and check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Store luggage at the resort if needed for a few extra hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, spend the afternoon doing any last-minute activities — a final street food snack run, a short beach walk, or visiting a nearby viewpoint. Head to the airport with plenty of time to spare (arrive 2-3 hours before departure).
day_by_day.evening: Depart Thailand with wonderful memories, a full stomach, and a camera full of beautiful photos. Reflect on the incredible beaches, delicious food, and vibrant culture experienced over 13 days.

meals.breakfast: Final Thai breakfast — khao man gai or congee from a local stall (70-90 THB)
meals.lunch: Airport food court or last street food meal near the resort (150-200 THB)
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or on the plane

day_by_day.notes: Keep some Thai Baht for airport taxes, last meals, and tips. Exchange remaining Baht back to your home currency at the airport. Thailand departure tax is usually included in flight tickets. Double-check all belongings and travel documents before departing.

trip_options.title: Classic Thailand Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at destination airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Collect luggage, clear immigration and customs. Arrange pre-booked airport transfer or take an official taxi to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and get acquainted with your beachfront room. Take a short stroll along the resort grounds to unwind from the flight.

meals.breakfast: On the plane
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Late-night snack at the resort's 24-hour lobby café or order room service to settle in comfortably after the long journey

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — arrival is late at night. Confirm your transfer in advance. Exchange some currency at the airport for small cash needs. Set an alarm for a relaxed start on Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. After breakfast, take your first walk along the beachfront to get oriented. Explore the immediate beach area — find a good sunbathing spot, dip your toes in the sea, and observe the local beach scene. Visit a nearby viewpoint or beachside promenade if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a beach chair and umbrella and spend the afternoon relaxing on the beach. Take a swim in the warm Gulf of Thailand or Andaman waters. Explore the resort's pool area as an alternative. Walk to the nearest local village or beach strip to browse small shops and get a feel for the neighborhood.
day_by_day.evening: Head to a nearby beachside night market or walking street for your first taste of authentic Thai street food. Try local classics like pad thai, mango sticky rice, and fresh coconut water. Watch the sunset from the beach before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast included — enjoy fresh tropical fruits, eggs, and Thai congee
meals.lunch: Casual beachside restaurant near the resort — try a fresh seafood platter or som tum (papaya salad) for around 150–250 THB
meals.dinner: Local night market street food — budget 150–300 THB for a full spread of pad thai, grilled skewers, and fresh fruit

day_by_day.notes: October is in the tail end of the wet season in some parts of Thailand — carry a light rain jacket. Stay hydrated in the tropical heat. Pick up a local SIM card at a nearby convenience store for affordable data.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise walk along the beach. After breakfast, join a local longtail boat tour departing from the nearest pier. Begin island hopping to a nearby smaller island — explore hidden coves, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, and discover secluded beaches away from the crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island-hopping tour to a second island. Enjoy a beach picnic lunch included in most tour packages. Snorkel around coral reefs, spot tropical fish, and swim in turquoise lagoons. Return to the main beach by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Freshen up at the resort. Head out to a mid-range seafood restaurant on the beachfront for a proper sit-down Thai dinner. Try grilled whole fish with chili and lime, tom yum soup, and jasmine rice. Enjoy the sea breeze and ambient lighting of a beachside dining experience.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or a local Thai café — try khao tom (rice porridge) with egg for an authentic morning meal
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch included in the island-hopping tour or a simple beachside shack on the island — fresh grilled corn, fruit, and water
meals.dinner: Beachfront seafood restaurant — budget 400–700 THB per person for a full Thai seafood dinner with drinks

day_by_day.notes: Book the island-hopping tour the evening before through the resort concierge or a local tour operator. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a dry bag, and a change of clothes. Wear water shoes for rocky shores.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early and explore the local morning market near the resort area. This is the best time to experience authentic Thai street food culture — vendors sell fresh noodle soups, fried dough sticks (patongo), and tropical fruits. Pick up snacks and interact with local vendors.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a half-day cooking class at a local Thai culinary school or resort cooking program. Learn to make 3–4 classic Thai dishes including green curry, pad kra pao (basil stir-fry), and tom kha gai. This hands-on experience gives deep insight into Thai flavors and ingredients.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the main beach road and explore the local bar and restaurant scene. Visit a rooftop bar or beachside lounge for sundowner cocktails. Try a classic Thai iced tea or Chang beer. Explore the evening street food scene for dessert — look for roti with banana and condensed milk.

meals.breakfast: Local morning market — bowl of boat noodles or fried rice with egg for 60–100 THB
meals.lunch: Eat the dishes you cooked in the cooking class — most classes include a sit-down meal of your creations
meals.dinner: Street food along the beach road — budget 200–350 THB for a mix of grilled meats, noodles, and desserts

day_by_day.notes: Cooking classes typically cost 800–1,500 THB per person and are bookable through the resort or local operators. Bring a notebook to jot down recipes. Morning markets usually wrap up by 9 AM — go early.

day_by_day.morning: Arrange a day trip to a nearby national marine park or protected island (such as Koh Lanta Marine Park, Ang Thong Marine Park, or Similan Islands depending on your location). Depart by speedboat early morning. Snorkel in pristine waters, hike to a viewpoint, and explore uninhabited island beaches.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring the marine park. Kayak through sea caves or mangrove tunnels. Swim at a secluded beach with emerald waters. Enjoy the natural beauty far from tourist crowds. Return to the resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at the resort pool or spa after the active day. Treat yourself to a traditional Thai massage at a local massage parlor near the resort (budget 300–500 THB for a 1-hour massage). Enjoy a quiet dinner at the resort restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before departure — grab fresh fruit and a coffee
meals.lunch: Packed lunch included in the marine park tour or simple food available at the park's visitor facilities
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant — try a Thai green curry with jasmine rice and a fresh fruit smoothie for a relaxed end to an active day, budget 350–600 THB

day_by_day.notes: Marine park day trips cost approximately 1,500–2,500 THB per person including transport, snorkel gear, and lunch. Book at least one day in advance. Bring motion sickness tablets if prone to seasickness on speedboats.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning yoga or meditation session on the beach if offered by the resort or a local wellness studio. Alternatively, rent a bicycle or scooter and explore the local area independently — discover hidden beaches, small temples, and local neighborhoods away from the tourist trail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local Buddhist temple (wat) in the nearest town. Dress respectfully (cover shoulders and knees). Observe monks, admire the architecture, and learn about Thai Buddhist culture. Afterward, explore the town's main street for local handicrafts, souvenirs, and fresh produce markets.
day_by_day.evening: Find a popular local restaurant recommended by the resort staff for an authentic Thai dinner. Try dishes less common on tourist menus such as khao soi (northern curry noodle soup), laab (spicy minced meat salad), or massaman curry. End the evening with a walk along the beach under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or a local bakery café — try a Thai-style breakfast of rice with slow-cooked pork and a soft-boiled egg
meals.lunch: Local town food court or market stall — sample regional specialties for 80–150 THB per dish
meals.dinner: Authentic local Thai restaurant recommended by locals — budget 300–500 THB per person for a multi-dish shared meal

day_by_day.notes: When visiting temples, always remove shoes before entering. A light scarf or sarong is useful to cover up. Scooter rentals cost around 250–400 THB per day — always wear a helmet and carry your passport copy.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint rest and recharge day. Sleep in and enjoy a long breakfast. Spend the morning by the resort pool or on the private beach. Read a book, enjoy a fresh coconut, and simply soak in the tropical atmosphere. This is a deliberate slow day to avoid burnout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a nearby beach that is less visited than the main resort beach. Walk or take a short tuk-tuk ride to reach it. Spend the afternoon swimming, beachcombing, and relaxing. Look for interesting shells, observe local fishermen, and enjoy the quieter setting.
day_by_day.evening: Join a sunset boat cruise if available locally — many operators offer 2-hour sunset cruises with drinks and snacks included. Watch the sun dip below the horizon from the water. Return to shore and enjoy a relaxed dinner at a mid-range restaurant with outdoor seating.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — take your time and try everything on the buffet
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a beach shack near the quieter beach — grilled fish, rice, and a cold Singha beer for around 200–300 THB
meals.dinner: Mid-range Thai restaurant with garden or beach seating — try a seafood BBQ platter with sticky rice for 400–650 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Sunset cruises cost approximately 600–1,200 THB per person. Book in the morning for the same evening. This slower day is intentional for a balanced trip — enjoy the downtime without guilt.

day_by_day.morning: Arrange a full-day trip to a more distant island group accessible by ferry or speedboat. Depart early to maximize time. Upon arrival, explore the island on foot or by rented bicycle. Visit the main beach, a viewpoint, and any local fishing village for an authentic glimpse of island life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel or dive at a recommended reef near the island. Many islands have reputable dive shops offering single dives for certified divers (around 1,200–1,800 THB) or introductory dives for beginners. Alternatively, join a guided kayaking tour around the island's coastline.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for sunset on the island before taking the last ferry back. Have dinner at a beachside restaurant on the island before departing — fresh catch of the day is always a great choice. Return to the resort by nightfall.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort before early departure — grab a banana, toast, and coffee
meals.lunch: Island beachside restaurant — fresh grilled prawns, papaya salad, and iced lime juice for 250–400 THB
meals.dinner: Island sunset dinner before the ferry back — try whole steamed fish with ginger and soy sauce for 350–500 THB

day_by_day.notes: Check ferry schedules carefully and confirm the last return time before departing. Bring cash as many island vendors do not accept cards. Pack sunscreen, water, and a light jacket for the boat ride back in the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Take a guided street food walking tour in the nearest town or city. A knowledgeable local guide will lead you through wet markets, hawker stalls, and hidden food alleys. Sample 8–10 different dishes including savory, sweet, and spicy items across 2–3 hours of walking and eating.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the food tour, explore the town independently. Visit a local fresh market to see exotic tropical fruits, spices, and seafood. Browse a few artisan shops for handmade souvenirs — look for locally made batik fabric, carved wooden items, and handcrafted jewelry. Rest at a local café with iced Thai coffee.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the most famous or busiest street food area in the region for dinner. Explore multiple stalls rather than sitting at one restaurant — this is the authentic street food experience. Try dishes you haven't had yet: oyster omelette, green papaya salad, coconut ice cream, and fried banana.

meals.breakfast: Included in the street food tour — the tour itself serves as a progressive breakfast and brunch experience
meals.lunch: Light snack at a local café after the tour — iced Thai tea and a slice of pandan cake for 80–120 THB
meals.dinner: Street food market dinner — budget 200–400 THB for a full spread from multiple vendors

day_by_day.notes: Street food walking tours cost approximately 800–1,500 THB per person and are bookable online or through the resort. Wear comfortable walking shoes. Carry hand sanitizer. The best street food is often found where locals queue — follow the crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Take a long-tail boat to explore sea caves, limestone karsts, and hidden lagoons in the area (similar to Phang Nga Bay or local equivalents). Paddle through narrow cave passages into secret enclosed lagoons (hongs). This is one of Thailand's most magical natural experiences.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the morning sea cave tour, spend the afternoon at a beautiful beach with calm waters. Rent a kayak independently and paddle along the coastline. Explore small rock formations, look for wildlife, and enjoy the freedom of self-guided exploration. Swim and sunbathe until late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a spa treatment — choose from a traditional Thai herbal compress massage or an aromatherapy session (budget 500–900 THB for 90 minutes). Have a quiet dinner at the resort or a nearby restaurant, reflecting on the highlights of the trip so far.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast before the early morning boat departure
meals.lunch: Beachside food stall near the afternoon beach — simple rice dishes, fresh fruit, and cold drinks for 150–250 THB
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant or nearby mid-range Thai restaurant — try a massaman curry with roti bread for a comforting end to the day, budget 350–550 THB

day_by_day.notes: Sea cave kayaking tours cost approximately 1,000–1,800 THB per person. These tours are tide-dependent — the guide will determine the best timing. Do not attempt sea caves independently without a guide. Waterproof phone cases are highly recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning on a final dedicated beach day at the resort's home beach. Swim, snorkel just offshore, and enjoy the beachfront setting you've been based at all trip. Rent a stand-up paddleboard or try a beginner surf lesson if waves are suitable. Take photos to capture the setting.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local elephant sanctuary or ethical wildlife experience if available in the region (always choose sanctuaries that do not offer riding). Observe and learn about elephant conservation, feed the elephants, and walk with them in a natural setting. This is a meaningful and responsible wildlife experience.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the near-end of the trip with a special dinner at the best mid-range restaurant you've discovered during your stay, or try somewhere new that has been recommended. Order a full Thai feast — multiple shared dishes, fresh seafood, and end with mango sticky rice for dessert.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — enjoy it slowly, savoring the tropical setting
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the elephant sanctuary café or a nearby local restaurant — simple Thai dishes for 150–250 THB
meals.dinner: Celebratory Thai dinner at a top local restaurant — budget 500–800 THB per person for a full spread with drinks

day_by_day.notes: Ethical elephant sanctuaries cost approximately 1,500–2,500 THB per person for a half-day experience. Research and book only certified ethical operators — avoid any venue offering elephant riding, shows, or performances.

day_by_day.morning: Final island or beach excursion — take a half-day snorkeling trip to a reef you haven't visited yet, or return to a favorite spot for one last swim. Alternatively, rent a kayak and paddle to a nearby small beach or cove for a private morning in nature.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Begin packing and organizing your belongings. Do a final souvenir shopping run — visit local markets or shops for last-minute gifts. Look for Thai silk scarves, ceramic elephant figurines, dried mango snacks, and quality Thai tea and coffee.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a final sunset on the beach — sit quietly, take it all in, and appreciate the journey. Have a farewell dinner at a restaurant that has become a favorite during your stay. Try any dishes you haven't yet tasted. Enjoy a final Thai iced tea or fresh coconut as the sun goes down.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — final morning to enjoy the full spread
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a beachside café — a refreshing green papaya salad and grilled chicken for 200–300 THB
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at a favorite local restaurant — budget 450–700 THB per person for a memorable final Thai meal

day_by_day.notes: Start packing the night before to avoid a rushed final morning. Keep a small bag with essentials for easy access on the last day. Confirm checkout time with the resort and arrange transport to the airport if departing the next day.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up for a final sunrise walk on the beach — a peaceful and memorable way to say goodbye to Thailand. Enjoy a last resort breakfast at a leisurely pace. Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort, ensuring all belongings are collected. Store luggage with the concierge if you have time before your transfer.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, use any remaining hours to revisit a favorite beach spot, grab last-minute street food snacks for the journey, or simply relax by the pool one last time. Head to the airport with plenty of time — allow at least 2–3 hours before departure for a domestic or international flight.
day_by_day.evening: Board your departure flight. Reflect on 13 incredible days of beaches, island hopping, and street food adventures across Thailand. Carry home memories of turquoise waters, vibrant flavors, warm hospitality, and tropical sunsets.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy every last bite of tropical fruits, Thai dishes, and fresh coffee
meals.lunch: Airport food court or a final street food stop on the way — grab a last pad thai or mango sticky rice for 100–200 THB
meals.dinner: On the plane or at the departure airport

day_by_day.notes: Keep some Thai Baht for airport snacks and any last-minute purchases. Exchange remaining Baht back to your home currency at the airport if needed. Ensure all duty-free purchases comply with your home country's customs regulations. Safe travels!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Thailand Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at destination airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. A private luxury transfer will be waiting to whisk you to Aegean Bliss Resort. Upon arrival, enjoy a warm welcome with a traditional Thai greeting, chilled towels, and a welcome drink. Check in, unwind on your beachfront terrace, and listen to the gentle sound of the waves.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable
meals.lunch: Not applicable
meals.dinner: Late-night in-room dining from the resort's premium menu — recommended: Tom Kha Gai soup and jasmine rice to ease into Thai cuisine after your flight.

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private airport transfer in advance. Keep the first night light — rest is the priority. Confirm resort check-in details and any special welcome amenities pre-booked.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Take a private sunrise beach walk along the resort's beachfront, followed by a rejuvenating 90-minute Thai herbal compress massage at the resort spa to recover from jet lag.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local beach area with a guided snorkeling excursion arranged by the resort. Discover vibrant coral reefs and tropical marine life in the crystal-clear waters just off the coast. Return to the resort for a refreshing dip in the infinity pool overlooking the sea.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll to a nearby beachside night market for an immersive street food experience. Sample local delicacies such as grilled satay skewers, mango sticky rice, pad Thai, and fresh coconut ice cream from artisan vendors.

meals.breakfast: Lavish buffet breakfast at the resort's ocean-view restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, made-to-order eggs, Thai congee, and freshly squeezed juices.
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort's beach club — grilled prawns, papaya salad, and a chilled coconut water.
meals.dinner: Premium street food night market experience — budget approximately 500–800 THB per person for a variety of authentic local bites and fresh seafood grills.

day_by_day.notes: October is shoulder season in Thailand — expect warm, humid weather with possible brief rain showers. Pack light rain gear and reef-safe sunscreen. Confirm snorkeling excursion timing with the resort concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a private longtail boat island-hopping excursion departing from the resort's private pier. Visit a secluded nearby island known for its powdery white sand and turquoise lagoon. Enjoy kayaking and paddleboarding in calm, clear waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island-hopping journey to a second island featuring dramatic limestone karsts and hidden sea caves. Snorkel in a protected marine sanctuary and explore the island's lush jungle trail with a private naturalist guide.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by sunset. Enjoy sundowners on the beach with artisan cocktails. Dine at the resort's signature fine dining restaurant featuring a contemporary Thai tasting menu.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast butler service — fresh fruit platter, croissants, Thai-style omelet, and premium coffee.
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic basket prepared by the resort chef, enjoyed on the secluded island beach — includes sandwiches, fresh fruit, cheese, and sparkling water.
meals.dinner: Resort signature restaurant — 7-course contemporary Thai tasting menu with wine or cocktail pairings. Expect dishes like wagyu beef massaman curry, lobster Tom Yum, and pandan panna cotta.

day_by_day.notes: Private longtail boat island-hopping should be pre-booked through the resort concierge. Bring waterproof bags for electronics. October weather may include afternoon rain showers — morning departures are recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Join a private Thai cooking class hosted at a luxury villa or the resort's culinary studio. Learn to prepare three iconic Thai dishes — green curry, som tum (papaya salad), and mango sticky rice — under the guidance of a celebrated local chef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby traditional fishing village by private boat. Explore the authentic local way of life, browse handmade crafts, and interact with local artisans. Visit a floating market if available in the area for a taste of authentic Thai commerce.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a private beachfront dinner set up on the sand with torchlit ambiance, personalized menu, and a dedicated butler — the ultimate luxury dining experience under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast with a dedicated à la carte station for Thai-style breakfast — rice porridge with condiments, fresh herbs, and fried dough sticks.
meals.lunch: Enjoy the fruits of your cooking class — sit down and savor the dishes you prepared with fellow guests or privately.
meals.dinner: Private beachfront candlelit dinner — customized 4-course menu prepared by the resort's executive chef. Includes a seafood tower, Thai red curry with lobster, and a decadent dessert selection.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm cooking class booking 48 hours in advance. The private beachfront dinner setup should be requested through the resort concierge at least one day ahead. Dress code: smart casual or resort elegant for the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Indulge in a full morning at the resort spa with a signature couple's or solo wellness journey — includes a traditional Thai massage, aromatherapy body scrub, and a floral bath ritual. Perfectly designed for deep relaxation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a private speedboat to a nearby uninhabited island for an exclusive afternoon. Swim in pristine waters, sunbathe on untouched beaches, and enjoy a chilled champagne setup arranged by the resort team.
day_by_day.evening: Head into the nearest town for an evening street food safari with a private food guide. Visit renowned local street stalls and hidden gems — try boat noodles, crab fried rice, grilled corn, and Thai iced tea.

meals.breakfast: Healthy wellness breakfast at the spa lounge — açai bowls, green smoothies, chia pudding, and herbal teas.
meals.lunch: Freshly prepared beachside lunch on the private island — grilled fresh catch of the day, tropical salads, and fresh coconut water served from the shell.
meals.dinner: Street food safari — guided tour of 6–8 local stalls and vendors. Budget 600–1,000 THB per person. Highlights include crab pad Thai, grilled seafood, and fresh durian for the adventurous.

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa wellness journey at least 24 hours in advance. The private island champagne setup is a premium add-on — confirm with the resort concierge. Street food safari guide can be arranged through the concierge or a reputable local tour operator.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise yoga session on the resort's beachfront deck led by a private instructor. Follow with a guided meditation and breathwork session to center yourself for the day ahead.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the surrounding coastal area on a private chartered catamaran sailing trip. Drift along the coastline, stop at scenic bays, and enjoy swimming and sunbathing on deck. A crew member will be on hand to serve drinks and snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Thai cultural performance — Muay Thai exhibition or classical Thai dance show — at a nearby cultural venue or arranged at the resort. Enjoy the rich heritage of Thai performing arts.

meals.breakfast: Light post-yoga breakfast at the resort — smoothie bowls, avocado toast with poached eggs, and cold brew coffee.
meals.lunch: Onboard the catamaran — catered gourmet lunch with fresh seafood, salads, chilled white wine, and tropical fruit.
meals.dinner: Fine dining at a top-rated restaurant near the resort — recommended: a renowned Thai seafood restaurant with panoramic ocean views. Signature dishes include steamed sea bass with lime and garlic, and whole grilled lobster.

day_by_day.notes: Catamaran charter should be booked 2–3 days in advance. Bring motion sickness medication if needed. October may bring gentle swells — confirm sea conditions with the charter operator the morning of the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a full-day premium island-hopping excursion to a more distant island group, departing by private speedboat. Arrive at a stunning island known for its emerald green waters and dramatic scenery. Hike to a viewpoint for panoramic vistas.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to another island in the group, famous for its vibrant coral gardens. Dive or snorkel with a certified guide. Explore sea turtles, rays, and colorful reef fish in their natural habitat. Relax on a secluded beach afterward.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by early evening. Freshen up and enjoy a romantic rooftop or elevated terrace dinner at the resort with sweeping ocean views and a curated cocktail menu.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast — energy-packed options including eggs benedict, granola, tropical fruits, and freshly pressed juice.
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet lunch box from the resort, enjoyed on the island — includes wraps, fruit, energy bars, and beverages.
meals.dinner: Resort rooftop or elevated terrace restaurant — recommended: grilled tiger prawns, Thai basil sea bass, and a premium Thai whiskey sour cocktail.

day_by_day.notes: Full-day island excursion requires early departure — arrange a 7:00–7:30 AM pickup. Apply reef-safe sunscreen throughout the day. Bring a dry bag, hat, and sunglasses. Confirm dive or snorkel certification requirements with the guide in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a free morning at leisure — sleep in, lounge by the infinity pool, or take a long walk on the beach. Optional: book a private paddleboard or kayak session along the resort's coastline.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in a private Thai street food cooking workshop in town, visiting a local market first to source fresh ingredients with your chef guide. Learn the art of balancing sweet, sour, salty, and spicy flavors in authentic Thai cuisine.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the local town's vibrant night bazaar. Browse artisan crafts, handmade jewelry, silk scarves, and local art. Enjoy the lively atmosphere with live music and street performances.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast — tropical fruit platter, eggs your way, Thai-style toast with pandan jam, and premium loose-leaf tea.
meals.lunch: Post-market cooking class lunch — enjoy the dishes you prepared, including fresh spring rolls, stir-fried basil chicken, and mango salad.
meals.dinner: Night bazaar street food exploration — grilled pork skewers, crispy fried oyster omelets, coconut pancakes, and freshly squeezed sugar cane juice. Budget 500–700 THB per person.

day_by_day.notes: The market cooking class is a highlight — book early as spots fill quickly. Bring cash (Thai Baht) for night bazaar shopping. Bargaining is expected and welcomed at local stalls.

day_by_day.morning: Take a private longtail boat to a nearby mangrove forest for a guided eco-tour. Paddle through the serene mangrove channels, spot exotic birds and wildlife, and learn about the ecological importance of mangrove ecosystems from your expert guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local Buddhist temple in the area for a cultural immersion experience. Participate in a merit-making ceremony, receive a monk's blessing, and explore the ornate temple architecture and golden shrines.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a luxurious evening. Enjoy a private sunset cocktail hour on your villa terrace, followed by dinner at the resort's beachfront grill.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — Thai-style congee with toppings, fresh pastries, seasonal fruits, and cold brew coffee.
meals.lunch: Casual beachside café near the temple area — recommended: pad see ew noodles, spring rolls, and fresh coconut water.
meals.dinner: Resort beachfront grill — whole grilled snapper with Thai herbs, grilled corn with chili butter, and a premium selection of Thai craft beers or cocktails.

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for temple visits — bring a sarong or lightweight scarf to cover shoulders and knees. Remove shoes before entering temple buildings. The mangrove tour is best done in the morning when wildlife is most active.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full morning of pure beach relaxation — set up on a premium sunbed with dedicated beach butler service. Optional: try stand-up paddleboarding, windsurfing, or jet skiing available through the resort's water sports center.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in an afternoon luxury spa treatment — choose from a deep tissue massage, hot stone therapy, or a traditional Thai herbal ball treatment. Finish with time in the steam room and relaxation lounge.
day_by_day.evening: Head out for a premium dining experience at one of the area's most acclaimed restaurants — a fine dining establishment known for its elevated Thai-French fusion cuisine and extensive wine cellar.

meals.breakfast: Resort pool-view breakfast — eggs benedict with smoked salmon, açai bowl, and a signature tropical fruit smoothie.
meals.lunch: Beach butler service lunch — gourmet sandwiches, fresh fruit, cold pressed juices, and a chilled glass of rosé wine.
meals.dinner: Thai-French fusion fine dining restaurant — recommended dishes include foie gras with tamarind glaze, lobster bisque with lemongrass, and a chocolate fondant with jasmine ice cream. Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Reserve the fine dining restaurant at least 2–3 days ahead as tables are limited. Smart dress code applies for the evening restaurant. The resort's water sports center may require advance booking for popular activities.

day_by_day.morning: Set out on a premium sunrise fishing excursion on a private charter boat. Try your hand at traditional Thai fishing techniques with a local fisherman guide. Enjoy the peaceful early morning sea and stunning sunrise views from the water.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby artisan village known for traditional Thai handicrafts — observe local weavers, pottery makers, and woodcarvers at work. Purchase unique handmade souvenirs and support local artisans directly.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private in-villa or in-room chef experience — a personal chef comes to your accommodation to prepare a bespoke multi-course Thai dinner just for you, using the freshest local ingredients.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the fishing excursion — energy bars, bananas, and thermos coffee from the resort.
meals.lunch: Cook and eat your morning catch! The charter boat captain can arrange to have your fresh fish grilled at a beachside shack near the pier — a truly authentic experience.
meals.dinner: Private in-villa chef dinner — customized 5-course Thai menu. Highlights: blue swimmer crab curry, pomelo salad, steamed sea bass, and taro coconut dessert.

day_by_day.notes: Sunrise fishing charter departs around 5:30–6:00 AM — arrange an early wake-up call. The private chef dinner should be booked 48 hours in advance through the resort concierge. Specify any dietary requirements or preferences.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning on a final premium island-hopping adventure to a hidden gem island — one of the less-visited, more secluded islands in the area. Enjoy complete privacy, pristine beaches, and crystal-clear waters with a private guide and boat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon at leisure — final pool time, last-minute spa treatment, or simply relaxing on the beach. Begin light packing and souvenir organizing.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your final full evening in Thailand with a grand farewell dinner at the resort's most prestigious dining venue. Enjoy a chef's special menu curated to highlight the best of Thai cuisine throughout your journey.

meals.breakfast: Lavish resort buffet breakfast — make the most of the full spread one last time with all your favorites.
meals.lunch: Casual beach club lunch — grilled seafood platter, fresh salads, and a final tropical cocktail by the sea.
meals.dinner: Farewell gala dinner at the resort's premier restaurant — chef's special 8-course tasting menu celebrating Thai culinary heritage. Includes champagne welcome, premium wine pairings, and a personalized dessert.

day_by_day.notes: Request a special farewell setup from the resort — many luxury properties offer complimentary touches like flower arrangements, personalized menus, or a small gift for departing guests. This is a wonderful night to reflect on the journey.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final leisurely morning at the resort. Take one last sunrise beach walk, collect shells, and soak in the view. Indulge in a final spa session or simply sit on your terrace with a coffee and enjoy the peaceful ambiance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout time — confirm with the resort; late checkout may be available upon request). Transfer to the airport via private luxury vehicle. Browse duty-free shops for last-minute Thai souvenirs — recommended: Thai silk, artisan snacks, and premium jasmine rice.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Thailand. Carry with you the memories of golden beaches, vibrant street food, island adventures, and the warmth of Thai hospitality.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — order your absolute favorites one last time. Treat yourself to a full Thai breakfast spread.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the airport's premium lounge or a nearby café before departure — recommend: a final bowl of Tom Yum soup or pad Thai to close the culinary journey.
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or airport lounge dinner depending on departure time.

day_by_day.notes: Request late checkout if your flight is in the afternoon or evening — most luxury resorts accommodate this subject to availability. Arrive at the airport at least 2.5–3 hours before international departure. Ensure all souvenirs comply with customs regulations — particularly fresh fruits or food items.
